WITH aylik AS (
    SELECT s.musteri_id,
           strftime('%Y-%m', s.tarih) AS ay,
           (CAST(strftime('%Y', s.tarih) AS INTEGER) * 12 +
            CAST(substr(s.tarih, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)) AS ay_no
    FROM siparisler s
    GROUP BY s.musteri_id, ay
),
seriler AS (
    SELECT musteri_id, ay,
           ay_no - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY musteri_id
               ORDER BY ay_no, ay
           ) AS grp
    FROM aylik
),
gruplar AS (
    SELECT musteri_id, grp,
           MIN(ay_no)  AS baslangic_no,
           COUNT(*)    AS uzunluk,
           MIN(ay)     AS baslangic_ay
    FROM seriler
    GROUP BY musteri_id, grp
),
en_uzun AS (
    SELECT musteri_id, baslangic_no, uzunluk,
           MAX(uzunluk) OVER (PARTITION BY musteri_id) AS en_uzun
    FROM gruplar
)
SELECT m.ad,
       e.uzunluk,
       strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(e.baslangic_no || '-01', '-1 month')) AS seri_baslangici
FROM en_uzun e
JOIN musteriler m ON m.id = e.musteri_id
WHERE e.uzunluk = e.en_uzun
  AND e.uzunluk >= 3
ORDER BY e.uzunluk DESC, m.ad ASC;
